errors.text_span: 纵轴表示对应义项数量
errors.evidence: The y-axis label in the figure is “义项数量”, but the bars represent the number of occurrences/counts of senses per category; the description is acceptable semantically, however it implies the x-axis categories are “义项出现次数的类别” while the x-axis actually lists counts 1, 2, 3, ..., 25+ and not abstract categories. More importantly, the caption indicates the figure is about the distribution of sense categories in the dataset, not an axis titled as such. This is a minor issue, but the prompt requires exact axis descriptions.
The description does not explicitly mention that each bar has a gray numeric label above it, which is a visible stylistic feature of the chart.
